adjudication.rationale: `parseRefreshTokenResponse` mutates the parsed token data to forcibly set `refresh_token` to the literal string "refresh_token" when it is missing (`if (!refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token) { refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"; }`). In `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the result is merged over the existing credentials (`o365AuthCredentials = { ...o365AuthCredentials, ...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data) };`) and then persisted via `prisma.credential.update(...)`. If the refresh response omits `refresh_token` (especially likely when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` + `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` causes use of the minimal schema that doesn't require it), the placeholder value overwrites the real stored refresh token and is written to the DB, causing unrecoverable credential corruption requiring re-auth.
